name: Sophia
full_description:
Sophia helps you grow your general knowledge in a few minutes a day.

• Short, clear courses on history, science, art, philosophy, and more
• Interactive quizzes after every course
• Daily streak to stay consistent
• Favorites, collections, and personalized recommendations

Start free. Unlock unlimited courses and quizzes with Premium (optional subscription via Google Play).
